introHtml: Flame resistant jackets provide essential protection for workers in oil, gas, electrical, and welding environments. Unlike standard work jackets, FR-rated fabrics self-extinguish and resist ignition, reducing burn injury severity. Customize with your company logo using heat-sealed or embroidered decoration that maintains fabric integrity. Choose from styles like zip-front or button-front, available in navy, khaki, and high-visibility orange. Safety managers and HR directors can order bulk quantities with consistent sizing and branding across your team.
